summary: Master Safety Data Management with our expert-led training course. Equip yourself with the tools to analyze data and enhance safety in your organization.
lede: Safety data management systems and analysis help you organize incident logs, near-miss reports, inspections, and corrective-action records into reliable information for decision-making. This course develops practical skills in incident classification, trend analysis, safety indicators, root-cause review, dashboards, and audit-ready recordkeeping. You will learn to use methods such as Pareto analysis and 5 Whys to identify patterns, assess control effectiveness, and prioritize actions. The course also introduces digital dashboards, automated trend monitoring, and data quality checks, helping you produce clear reports and evidence-based briefings even when records are incomplete or time for manual analysis is limited.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who manage, analyze, or report safety information and need practical methods for turning records into action.
prerequisites: Participants should have working knowledge of workplace safety processes, incident reporting, and basic spreadsheet use. No coding is required, but you should be comfortable reading charts, tables, and operational records. Prior exposure to ISO 45001 or a formal safety management system is helpful but not mandatory.
